newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's Popular Book gets approval for listing.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Popular Book gets approval for listing.

text.p: Bilingual bookstore chain Popular Book Company said on Monday it obtained approval for a listing on the mainboard of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
It said in a statement its initial public offering would be handled by Keppel Bank, but did not disclose when it hoped to list or the amount it would raise.
The company had a turnover of Singapore $126.4 million in its financial year ended April 30, 1996, representing a compounded growth rate of 22.5 percent.

The bookstore, founded in 1924 as an importer and distributor of Chinese books and magazines, is now an integrated business engaged in publishing, distribution of office products, bookstore operations and franchising.
It has operations in Singapore, Malaysia and HongKong.
